name: faster-whisper
summary: [Faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2, which is a fast inference engine for Transformer models. This container provides a Wyoming protocol server for faster-whisper.

tags.description: Releases with Nvidia GPU support (amd64 only)
Legacy releases with Nvidia GPU support for pre-Turing cards (amd64 only)

volumes.description: Local path for Whisper config files.

env.name: DEBUG
env.description: If set to `true`, or any other value, the container will output debug logs.

env.name: LOCAL_ONLY
env.description: If set to `true`, or any other value, the container will not attempt to download models from HuggingFace and will only use locally-provided models.

env.name: WHISPER_BEAM
env.description: Number of candidates to consider simultaneously during transcription.

env.name: WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE
env.description: Compute type used by CTranslate2, e.g. `float16`, `int8_float16`, `int8`. Leave at `default` to let faster-whisper choose.

env.name: WHISPER_LANG
env.description: Two character code for the language that you will speak to the add-on.

env.name: WHISPER_MODEL
env.description: Whisper model that will be used for transcription. From [here](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper/blob/master/faster_whisper/utils.py#L11-L31).

docs.setup:
For use with Home Assistant [Assist](https://www.home-assistant.io/voice_control/voice_remote_local_assistant/), add the Wyoming integration and supply the hostname/IP and port that Whisper is running add-on."

When using the `gpu` tag with Nvidia GPUs, make sure you set the container to use the `nvidia` runtime and that you have the [Nvidia Container Toolkit](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit) installed on the host and that you run the container with the correct GPU(s) exposed. See the [Nvidia Container Toolkit docs](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/sample-workload.html) for more details.

For more information see the [faster-whisper docs](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper),

changelog.text: Add `WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE` for selecting the CTranslate2 compute type.
Default to `auto` for model and language if not set.
Add gpu-legacy branch for pre-Turing cards.
Build from Github releases rather than Pypi.
Bump CUDA to 12 on GPU branch.
